low.title: Low-Budget Half-Day Hallstatt Mixed Route
low.summary: A simple, affordable blend of nature, history, and charming village alleys — plus cheap local bites.

schedule.title: Lakeside Start
schedule.description: Begin with the classic Hallstatt lakeside panorama — calm, reflective, and perfect for morning photos.

schedule.title: Old Town Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Explore narrow alleys, wooden balconies, and traditional alpine details.

schedule.title: Budget Snack Break
schedule.description: Grab a pretzel, pastry, or simple sandwich to keep the energy up.

schedule.title: Church Terrace Viewpoint
schedule.description: A hybrid highlight: nature + history + architecture all in one iconic viewpoint.

schedule.title: Calm Lakeside Path
schedule.description: Finish with a peaceful walk along the water before wrapping up the route.

medium.title: Balanced Half-Day Hallstatt Mixed Experience
medium.summary: A smooth blend of culture, views, gentle nature walks, and a mid-range meal.

schedule.title: Café Lakeside Start
schedule.description: Warm up with a pastry or tea while enjoying the early-morning reflections.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Museum – Highlights Tour
schedule.description: See a curated selection of Hallstatt’s cultural, artistic, and archaeological treasures.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: A balanced Austrian meal — just enough to fuel the rest of the walk.

schedule.title: Forest Edge Walk + Waterfall Peek
schedule.description: A light nature detour toward the Mühlbach waterfall area.

schedule.title: Lakefront Finish
schedule.description: End at a peaceful shoreline spot with perfect views.

high.title: High-End Mixed Hallstatt Highlights
high.summary: A refined half-day combining curated culture, elegant scenery, and high-quality dining.

schedule.title: Elegant Breakfast With a View
schedule.description: Start your day with beautiful plating and premium lake scenery.

schedule.title: Curated Museum Experience
schedule.description: Take a guided or self-paced tour through artifacts, early craftsmanship, and historic exhibits.

schedule.title: High-Quality Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy refined Austrian specialties made with local alpine ingredients.

schedule.title: Upper Village Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Discover artistic angles, wooden facades, and panoramic viewpoints.

schedule.title: Premium Lakeside Moment
schedule.description: Wrap up with serene views and golden light by the water.

schedule.title: Luxury Breakfast Start
schedule.description: Premium pastries, scenic terrace seating, and calm alpine air.

schedule.title: Guided Museum + Heritage Walk
schedule.description: A polished cultural experience with time to appreciate Hallstatt’s ancient roots.

schedule.title: Fine Alpine Lunch
schedule.description: Beautifully plated dishes inspired by local ingredients.

schedule.title: Exclusive Forest Path + Viewpoints
schedule.description: A gentle nature segment with fresh air and quiet scenery.

schedule.title: Signature Lakeside Finale
schedule.description: End with a calm, picturesque lakeside moment — the perfect Hallstatt blend.
